label: D2 rare a2->S1 after unrewarded trial, scaled by belief that S2 is good
terms: (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 1) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 1) * (prev_reward == 0) * np.clip(-belief_lo, 0, 6) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 1) * (prev_reward == 0) * np.clip(-belief_lo - 2, 0, 6) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (belief_cover < 3) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("state", -1) == 1) * (tv("action", -1) == 2)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (zero at D1/GO). Magnitude is carried by the trials where the agent chose a2, reached S1 by a rare transition, and the previous trial was unrewarded. The indicator alone gives dev R^2 beyond timing ~0.32. Scaling it by the ideal observer belief that S2 is good (clipped -belief_lo, with an extra convex term for strong S2 belief) raises dev R^2 to ~0.60: the stronger the observed evidence that S2 is good, the larger the activation. Smaller additions: a bump when belief_cover is low (start of the window, where the belief is weak but the agent is probably still confident), and a bump when the previous trial was also a2->S1 (repeated rare outcomes); together dev 0.61. a2->S1 after a rewarded trial, and every other choice x state, are near zero. Uses only observed variables (no value/policy, no future). The profile ceiling all=0.26 / all observed=0.22 is far below this because those tables lack the interaction with belief. Remaining misses: some repeated a2->S1u trials where the activation drops to 0 although belief still favours S2, and early window trials where the belief is weak. The earlier label used the policy (still strongly favouring a2); the observed belief seems to stand in for it with little loss.

issues: Large systematic gap the label leaves out: episode time interacts with the trigger. The timing baseline is additive, so it cannot switch off the trigger condition. Within B = D2*a2*S1*prev_reward==0, fitted offsets relative to mid-episode are: ep_trial<3 -0.41, 3-5 -0.36, 6-9 -0.34, 75-79 -0.09, 80-84 -0.24, 85-89 -0.40, >=90 -0.41, against a base weight of +0.42. So the feature is about 0 on trials before 10 and from 85 on. Adding just two ep-time gates to the claimed terms raises dev R^2 from 0.626 to 0.699. The worst misses (t85-t96 windows with predicted 0.69 and actual 0) are this class. Misses names only 'early-window trials where the belief is weak', which is a different thing.

The claim that 'scaling by belief raises dev to 0.60' credits belief alone, but belief is redundant with the previous trial's pattern. B plus last_is('a2 S1 u'), last_is('a2 S2 u') and last_is('a1 S1 u'), with no belief, scores dev 0.601 / test 0.577. B plus the two belief terms scores dev 0.599 / test 0.571. Both together score dev 0.626 / test 0.600. The previous trial (a2->S1 unrewarded raises it; a2->S2 unrewarded lowers it strongly, weight -0.34; a1->S1 unrewarded lowers it) does as well as the ideal-observer belief. Belief adds only about 0.02 beyond it.
belief_cover<3 adds nothing on top of the indicator alone (B + cover<3: dev 0.316 / test 0.280, the same as B alone at 0.28 test). It only helps once the other terms are in.

The confirmed claims hold: the feature is zero at D1/GO, D2 a2->S1 after an unrewarded trial is the trigger (indicator test 0.28), a2->S1 after a rewarded trial stays near zero (residual -0.012), and the claimed terms reproduce test 0.582.

Remaining unexplained class even after the fixes: the activation dies out within runs of repeated a2->S1 unrewarded trials (e.g. t71-74: 0.96, 0.20, 0, 0, predicted about 0.85) even though belief keeps favouring S2. Neither belief nor two-back history terms capture this (two-back a2 S1 u term weight about 0, dev unchanged at 0.60).
No direct comparison with the policy was possible in observed-only mode, so the claim that the observed belief stands in for the policy 'with little loss' is unverified.
skeptic.revised_label: D2 rare a2->S1 after an unrewarded trial, mid-episode only (trials 10-84, weaker from 75 on). Larger when the observed history favours S2 (previous trial a2->S1 unrewarded, or strong S2 belief), smaller after an a2->S2 or a1->S1 unrewarded trial. Dies out within long runs of repeats.
